title: fix(app-shell): map ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED to the localized multi-org-disabled sentence
body:
Fixes #12977
Clause-②: no

## What

`ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/orgErrorMessage.ts`) gains one row: objectstack's registered code `ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED` (ADR-0112; the ledger row in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` on objectstack `main`) maps to `workspace.multiOrgDisabled`, the sentence the create-workspace dialog's own `multiOrgEnabled === false` guard already shows. Every pack already translates it, so no locale key is added.

Before: a create refused with that code (the dialog's guard had not settled, or its `/auth/config` read failed) took `resolveOrgErrorMessage`'s verbatim leg and showed "Creating additional organizations is disabled on this deployment." in every locale. After: the localized guard sentence.

- Not `organization.errors.notAllowedToCreate`: it reads as a missing grant, and the ledger says this refusal is a deployment setting.
- The resolver calls `t(entry.key)` with no namespace constraint (the dialog's own fallback already passes `workspace.createFailed`), so a key outside `organization.errors` is reachable; the `OrgErrorEntry.key` doc comment now says so.
- The `YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_CREATE_A_NEW_ORGANIZATION` row stays (out of scope per the card).
- The module header no longer states a row count, and names the new row's provenance.

## Pins (`orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts`)

- New: a rejection with `code: 'ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED'` and the server's English sentence resolves to the zh `workspace.multiOrgDisabled` sentence.
- CONTROL: an unmapped code (`ORGANIZATION_SLUG_LOCKED_BY_ACTIVE_ENVIRONMENTS`) still degrades to the server's sentence.
- The enumeration pin's key set gains the member; its name stops calling every member a better-auth code.

## Ablation (one-shot, not kept)

Committed the fix first, then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` (objectstack) dropped the row: anchor 1 to 0, blob `02e66dd11b7c` to `f78de5adb3d3`. Under the lock the pin file went **2 failed, 11 passed**: the zh pin (Received "Creating additional organizations is disabled on this deployment.") and the enumeration pin; the control stayed green. Restore proven: blob after restore == HEAD blob `02e66dd11b7c`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../orgErrorMessage` from source, so no build sits between mutation and run.

## Verification (at `3867486903`)

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`: exit 0 (28/28 tasks).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.ts`): exit 0.
- vitest `--maxWorkers=1` over every test file naming `orgErrorMessage`, `resolveOrgErrorMessage`, `ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS` or `multiOrgDisabled` (4 files, from `git grep -l`): 4 files / 78 tests passed.
- eslint narrowed to the two changed source files: exit 0, 2 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings; the resolved config sets no `parserOptions` (no type-aware linting), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Battery, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new).
- **Declared to CI, not run locally:** the whole `packages/app-shell/` vitest directory (the dispatch forbids whole-package-directory runs on the shared box).
